rationale: Resuming fermentation after turn 3 zero-growth anomaly. Using abundant glucose and lactate as primary C sources; arginine, alanine, serine for N. Ferment to acetate, propionate, succinate, CO2. Carbon balance: 48 mmol C in (glucose 36 + lactate 6 + arginine 6) minus 8 mmol C out (products) leaves 40 mmol C for ~0.95 g biomass; nitrogen available (8 mmol N) limits to 0.8 /h growth.
